description: Search upcoming academic conferences, workshops and calls for papers by words in the title, organizer, location, field, date or topic. Pass 1 to 4 short topic, organizer or place words (for example 'macroeconomics Europe' or 'corporate finance'); omit filler words such as 'conferences', 'CFP', 'call for papers' or 'upcoming'. Optionally filter by research field, world region, or open calls only. Returns at most 10 events with their ResearchCal page and official source URL.

field.description: Research field key, for example 'economics', 'business', 'finance' or 'political_science'. See server instructions or list_calendars for the current fields.
field.title: Field

open_calls_only.description: Return only events with an open submission or application call, ordered by soonest deadline first.
open_calls_only.title: Open Calls Only

query.description: Short search words, for example 'macroeconomics Europe' or 'corporate finance'.
query.title: Query

region.description: World region: europe, north_america, latin_america, asia, mena, africa or oceania.
region.title: Region

name: search

dates.description: Event dates as text, or empty.
dates.title: Dates

id.description: Event id. Pass it to fetch for details.
id.title: Id
